review.boundary_review: The principal page runs from about x320 to x3110. The gutter is at about x3110-3130. Right of the gutter, the shelfmark column of fol. 293 is visible and is not transcribed. The '-√c. 341(6)' dash is part of fol. 293. In the adjacent fol. 293 image, the '…ṇāmaṇi- ←' and the dash at the c. 275 row lie on this page (292b), seen at the photo edge, and are not duplicate records. The cross-page attachment of b003 is probable; that of b002 is unresolved.

region_review.top: Folio number '292b.' only. The rest is blank ruled paper.
region_review.middle: The b002 note with its pencil arrow, the faint pencil '5' above it, and small ink specks at about (1730,2395) and (2180,3040). The specks are not text.
region_review.bottom: The two-line b003 note. Below it the page is blank ruled paper to the lower edge. No bottom note was found.
region_review.left_margin: Both b002 and b003 begin in the left margin and cross the ruled line at about x820. No other marginal writing.
region_review.right_margin: Nothing between the text area and the gutter apart from the two arrows. The facing-page strip is excluded.
region_review.interlinear: 'or' above the bracketed reading in b003 line 1. No other interlinear text.
